Government scheme timeline

Before 10 May 2026

100-unit free supply baseline

The comparison includes the previous lower rate on units 101–200 for eligible usage up to 500.

10 May 2026 · Reported effective date

200 free units for eligible homes

Reported under G.O.(Ms) No.50. Above 500 units, the existing 100-unit allowance continues. Current calculator behaviour was checked on 08 Oct 2026.

08 Oct 2026 · Calculator check

500 units: ₹1,570 · 501 units: ₹2,048

The official calculator confirms the current threshold and slab schedule. Transition-period bills need separate checking.

*The old baseline is reconstructed from published tariff/subsidy descriptions; original historical orders and transition rules are not fully verified. This is a comparison estimate, not a certified historical bill.

What this version covers

Normal domestic two-month energy bills. Monthly or irregular cycles, solar settlement, business bills, meter multipliers and bills spanning a policy change need separate rules. Deposits, arrears, late fees and credits are not included.

This is a checked snapshot, not a live government feed. Rules will need review when new orders are issued.
